claims.claim: Kelowna General Hospital had the longest median waits in British Columbia in 2025 for routine and urgent CT scans.
claims.episode_span: Kelowna General Hospital had the longest median waits in British Columbia in 2025
claims.source_title: Kelowna hospital among longest waits for CT scans, new data reveals
claims.supporting_quote: The analysis, based on scans in 2025, shows KGH had the longest median waits in B.C. for both routine and urgent CT scans.

claims.claim: The median wait for a routine CT at Kelowna General was 210 days, against a provincial target of 60 days, and one in ten people waited longer than 607 days.
claims.episode_span: The median wait for a routine CT was 210 days, more than three times the provincial target of 60 days, and one in ten people waited longer than 607 days.
claims.source_title: Kelowna hospital among longest waits for CT scans, new data reveals
claims.supporting_quote: For routine scans, the median wait was 210 days, more than three times the provincial target of 60 days.

claims.claim: The median wait for an urgent CT at Kelowna General was 76 days against a seven-day target, and one in ten patients waited longer than 245 days.
claims.episode_span: For urgent CT scans the median was 76 days, against a seven-day target, and one in ten patients waited longer than 245 days.
claims.source_title: Kelowna hospital among longest waits for CT scans, new data reveals
claims.supporting_quote: For urgent CT scans, the median wait was 76 days, compared with the seven-day target.

claims.claim: At Kelowna General the median routine MRI wait was 160 days against a 60-day target, and the median urgent MRI wait was 27 days against a seven-day benchmark.
claims.episode_span: MRI waits at the hospital also missed targets: 160 days for a routine scan against a 60-day target
claims.source_title: Kelowna hospital among longest waits for CT scans, new data reveals
claims.supporting_quote: The median wait for a routine MRI was 160 days compared with a provincial target of 60 days.

claims.claim: Suzanne Summers-Gill said her doctor suggested travelling to Salmon Arm for a CT, and she made a round trip of more than 200 kilometres.
claims.episode_span: Suzanne Summers-Gill said her doctor suggested she go to Salmon Arm; she made a round trip of more than 200 kilometres
claims.source_title: Kelowna hospital among longest waits for CT scans, new data reveals
claims.supporting_quote: Not wanting to wait to determine whether she had a serious health issue, Summers-Gill made the more than 200-kilometre round trip and got her CT scan within a couple of weeks.

claims.claim: B.C. Health Minister Ryan Peterson said the ministry plans a comprehensive review including medical imaging and that there is no solution today.
claims.episode_span: Health Minister Ryan Peterson said the ministry plans a comprehensive review, including access to imaging, that there is no solution today
claims.source_title: Kelowna hospital among longest waits for CT scans, new data reveals
claims.supporting_quote: “We don’t have a solution today because we need to listen to our workers and what that looks like,” said health minister Ryan Peterson.
